pools.name: ocean
pools.notes: Non-custodial coinbase payouts and DATUM miner-built templates, which reduce the pool fee to 1%.
pools.description: OCEAN launched in late 2023 with a focus on miner sovereignty. Miners receive payouts directly in the block's coinbase transaction — no account, no custody. Through the DATUM protocol, miners can build their own block templates and choose which transactions to include. The pool uses Bitcoin Knots and supports BOLT12 Lightning payouts for sub-threshold balances.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial). Lightning available via BOLT12 for amounts below the 0.01 BTC on-chain threshold.

pools.name: antpool
pools.notes: Offers daily automatic settlement, merged-mining rewards, and multiple earnings modes.
pools.description: AntPool is operated by Bitmain and is one of the largest Bitcoin mining pools by hashrate. It offers FPPS and PPLNS payout modes with daily automatic settlement. The pool supports merged mining for auxiliary coins and targets professional mining operations with subaccounts and farm management tools.
pools.payout_method: Account balance with automatic daily wallet payouts. Minimum payout 0.005 BTC.
pools.geographic_presence: Global with geo-routed endpoints across US, Russia, Germany, Hong Kong, Dubai, and more.

pools.name: f2pool
pools.notes: FPPS fee is 4%, PPLNS fee is 2%, with auxiliary merged-mining rewards.
pools.description: F2Pool is one of the longest-running Bitcoin mining pools, operational since 2013. It offers FPPS (4% fee) and PPLNS (2% fee) modes with merged mining rewards for HTR, ELA, NMC, and others. The pool maintains regional endpoints across six continents with SSL options available.
pools.payout_method: Account balance with automatic daily on-chain payouts. Lightning withdrawals available for amounts below 0.005 BTC. Minimum payout 0.005 BTC.
pools.geographic_presence: Regional endpoints in Asia, North America, Europe, Africa, Latin America, plus universal and SSL endpoints.

pools.name: viabtc
pools.notes: PPS+ is the 4% default, PPLNS is 2%, with merged mining paying several auxiliary coins.
pools.description: ViaBTC is a major mining pool offering PPS+, PPLNS, and Solo modes for Bitcoin. PPS+ charges 4% on the block subsidy component plus 2% on transaction fees; PPLNS is 2%. The pool supports merged mining for ELA, NMC, SYS, and FB.
pools.payout_method: Account balance with automatic daily wallet payouts. Minimum 0.001 BTC.
pools.geographic_presence: Global and Europe-specific endpoints with TLS. Exact server cities not disclosed.

pools.name: spiderpool
pools.notes: FPPS fee is 4%, PPLNS fee is 1%, with regional TLS endpoints and merged-mining rewards.
pools.description: SpiderPool provides FPPS (4%) and PPLNS (1%) Bitcoin mining with five regional endpoint groups. Each region offers multiple failover ports plus dedicated TLS connections. The pool supports merged mining for FB and DMT-NAT.
pools.payout_method: Account balance with automatic daily wallet payouts. Minimum 0.005 BTC.
pools.geographic_presence: Dedicated endpoints in North America, South America, Asia, Europe, and Africa.

pools.name: secpool
pools.notes: FPPS charges 4% while PPLNS is currently fee-free, with merged-mining rewards.
pools.description: SecPool provides FPPS (4%) and PPLNS (0% fee) Bitcoin mining with daily settlement. It maintains universal endpoints plus dedicated Russia-region servers. The pool supports merged mining for FB and NMC.
pools.payout_method: Account balance with automatic daily wallet payouts. Minimum 0.002 BTC.
pools.geographic_presence: Universal endpoint plus dedicated Russia servers.

pools.name: binance_pool
pools.notes: Daily BTC earnings credited custodially to the miner's Binance Funding Wallet.
pools.description: Binance Pool is the mining service operated by Binance. Earnings are credited directly to the miner's Binance Funding Wallet. Public documentation on connection details, fees, and infrastructure is limited.
pools.payout_method: Custodial — earnings credited to Binance account balance.

pools.name: braiins_pool
pools.notes: Supports free Lightning payouts from one satoshi and encrypted Stratum V2.
pools.description: Braiins Pool (formerly Slush Pool) is the world's first Bitcoin mining pool, operational since December 2010. It uses FPPS with a 2.5% fee (0% effective fee for miners using Braiins OS firmware). The pool supports both Stratum V1 and V2, offers Lightning payouts from as low as 1 satoshi, and provides a global auto-routing endpoint.
pools.payout_method: Account balance with automatic on-chain or Lightning payouts. Minimum 0.0002 BTC on-chain, 1 sat via Lightning.
pools.geographic_presence: Global with automatic geographic endpoint selection.

pools.name: ckpool
pools.notes: Anonymous registration-free solo mining with geographically distributed endpoints.
pools.description: CKPool is the trust anchor of Bitcoin solo mining. Operational since 2014, its open-source ckpool/libckpool software powers the majority of solo pools in the ecosystem — including AtlasPool, Parasite, Braiins Solo, and many others listed on this site. The pool requires no registration; miners connect with their Bitcoin address and receive the full block reward (minus 2% fee) directly in the coinbase transaction.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial). The miner's address is placed directly in the block's coinbase transaction. No account, no withdrawal, no custody.
pools.geographic_presence: Servers in US-East, US-West, Germany, Singapore, and Australia. Connecting to stratum.ckpool.org automatically routes to the nearest server.

pools.name: atlaspool
pools.notes: Uses global low-latency infrastructure and pays 98.5% of a found block directly to the miner's wallet.
pools.description: AtlasPool is a high-performance solo mining pool built on ckpool with a serious infrastructure focus. It operates 100+ anycast edge nodes globally that terminate at 9 dedicated stratum backend servers across six continents. Miners connect to a single hostname and BGP anycast routes them to the lowest-latency endpoint automatically.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial). 98.5% of block reward paid directly to the miner's wallet address.
pools.geographic_presence: Global anycast with stratum backends in Ashburn VA (US), Portland OR (US), São Paulo (BR), Frankfurt (DE), London (UK), Hong Kong (HK), Mumbai (IN), Sydney (AU), and Cape Town (ZA).

pools.name: public_pool
pools.notes: Fully open source with Stratum V1 TLS, Stratum V2, DATUM, and separate solo and shared-payout endpoints.
pools.description: Public Pool is a fully open-source, zero-fee Bitcoin mining pool offering both Solo and PPLNS modes. It supports Stratum V1, TLS, Stratum V2, and DATUM connections — all without requiring an account. The pool provides detailed per-device-type statistics showing hashrate and worker counts broken down by miner hardware.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial) for Solo mode. Proportional for PPLNS.
pools.geographic_presence: Single hosted instance. Location not publicly disclosed.

pools.name: parasite
pools.notes: Hybrid model awards 1 BTC to the block finder and distributes the remainder proportionally through Lightning.
pools.description: Parasite Pool uses a unique hybrid payout model. When a block is found, the finder receives 1 BTC directly in the coinbase transaction. The remaining block reward plus transaction fees are distributed proportionally to all participants based on shares since the last block, paid via Lightning. The pool also runs prize programs awarding ordinals and hardware to miners who submit high-difficulty shares.
pools.payout_method: Hybrid — 1 BTC direct coinbase to the finder, remainder distributed proportionally via Lightning (minimum 10 sats).
pools.geographic_presence: Global with nodes in Ashburn (US), Frankfurt (DE), and others.

pools.name: pyblock
pools.notes: Registration-free solo pool that also provides a DATUM gateway for mining OCEAN templates.
pools.description: PyBLOCK is a non-custodial mining service focused on sovereignty and anti-spam block template policy. It offers Lotto (solo), DATUM TIDES, native Stratum V2, CHIRP, and Carousel modes — all with BIP-110 signaling variants available. The pool runs Bitcoin Knots.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase for Lotto/SV2/CHIRP modes. OCEAN TIDES for DATUM mode.

pools.name: solomining_de
pools.notes: Fully open-source, fee-free German solo pool with a dedicated TLS endpoint.
pools.description: SoloMining DE is a fully open-source, zero-fee Bitcoin solo pool based in Germany. It uses the Public Pool codebase and offers standard and TLS connections. No registration required.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial).

pools.name: mineshop
pools.notes: Fee-free direct coinbase rewards and Mining Chest loyalty points redeemable on hardware.
pools.description: MineShop operates a registration-free, zero-fee Bitcoin solo pool from Nuremberg, Germany. It runs Bitcoin Core v29.3 and offers a Mining Chest store-points loyalty program (100 points = €1, redeemable for up to 20% off miners).
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial).

pools.name: bitcoinmerch
pools.notes: Solo pool hosted in Fremont, California.
pools.description: BitcoinMerch operates a Bitcoin solo pool using the Public Pool interface with a 2% fee. It offers standard and TLS connections with no registration required.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial).

pools.name: 2miners_eu
pools.notes: Regional SSL endpoints, automatic two-hour payouts, monitoring bots, and covered payout fees.
pools.description: 2Miners provides dedicated Bitcoin solo mining with physical servers in Europe, the United States, and Asia. The pool charges 1.5% and pays accumulated balances automatically every two hours. All regions offer SSL/TLS connections. Compatible with NiceHash and Mining Rig Rentals.
pools.payout_method: Wallet-address account balance with automatic payout every 2 hours. Minimum 0.05 BTC. Pool covers tx fees.

pools.name: 2miners_us
pools.notes: Regional SSL endpoints, automatic two-hour payouts, monitoring bots, and covered payout fees.
pools.description: 2Miners provides dedicated Bitcoin solo mining with physical servers in Europe, the United States, and Asia. The pool charges 1.5% and pays accumulated balances automatically every two hours. All regions offer SSL/TLS connections. Compatible with NiceHash and Mining Rig Rentals.
pools.payout_method: Wallet-address account balance with automatic payout every 2 hours. Minimum 0.05 BTC. Pool covers tx fees.

pools.name: 2miners_asia
pools.notes: Regional SSL endpoints, automatic two-hour payouts, monitoring bots, and covered payout fees.
pools.description: 2Miners provides dedicated Bitcoin solo mining with physical servers in Europe, the United States, and Asia. The pool charges 1.5% and pays accumulated balances automatically every two hours. All regions offer SSL/TLS connections. Compatible with NiceHash and Mining Rig Rentals.
pools.payout_method: Wallet-address account balance with automatic payout every 2 hours. Minimum 0.05 BTC. Pool covers tx fees.

pools.name: letsmineit
pools.notes: PROP hybrid pays 50% to the block finder, distributes 49% proportionally, retains 1% as fee.
pools.description: LetsMineIt offers account-free Bitcoin mining in Solo and proportional (PROP) modes. The PROP hybrid pays 50% to the block finder and distributes 49% proportionally, retaining 1% as its fee. Endpoints available in multiple regions.
pools.payout_method: Direct to the worker wallet after block confirmation.
pools.geographic_presence: UK, Poland, Germany, France, US, Singapore.

pools.name: solofury
pools.notes: Non-custodial direct coinbase payouts with native TLS across nine regions and five SHA-256 coins.
pools.description: SoloFury is a non-custodial solo mining pool operating nine named regional servers across five continents. Built on a ckpool fork, it supports BTC, BCH, and other SHA-256 coins with 1% fee and direct coinbase payouts. No registration required.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial).
pools.geographic_presence: Atlanta, Seattle, Frankfurt, London, Tel Aviv, Johannesburg, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo.

pools.name: noderunners
pools.notes: Community-operated, fee-free CKPool-based service with TLS available on port 1336.
pools.description: NodeRunners operates a zero-fee, donation-funded Bitcoin solo pool as part of a broader Bitcoin education and node-running community. The pool uses CKPool-based software with TLS available on port 1336. No registration required.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial).

pools.name: blitzpool
pools.notes: Solo is free, PPLNS costs 1%, group modes cost 1.5%, all with non-custodial coinbase settlement.
pools.description: BlitzPool is a non-custodial Bitcoin pool built in Switzerland offering Solo (0% fee), PPLNS (1%), Group Solo (1.5%), and Blockparty (1.5%) modes. It supports Stratum V1, V2 with auto-detection, TLS, and Job Declaration. Runs Blitzpool server v2.2.5 on Bitcoin Core 31.0.0.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase for Solo/Group/Blockparty. PPLNS uses signed credit ledger with 5,000 sat minimum.

pools.name: helios
pools.notes: Supports low-hashrate hobby devices and pays 99% directly through the block's coinbase transaction.
pools.description: HeliosPool is a community-run solo mining pool using a modified CKPool stack. It maintains Bitcoin servers in three continental regions with standard and high-difficulty ports in each. Welcomes everything from small hobby devices to full ASICs.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial). 99% of block reward paid to miner.
pools.geographic_presence: Montreal, Canada; Sydney, Australia; Gravelines, France.

pools.name: solopool_com
pools.notes: Solo Split lets each miner choose a solo-versus-proportional ratio through the Stratum password.
pools.description: SoloPool.com is a non-custodial Bitcoin pool offering Solo, Prop+, and an adjustable Solo Split mode where miners choose their shared-reward percentage (0-100%) through the Stratum password field. Operates six named regional endpoints plus a global auto-routing address.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial) across all modes. Multi-output coinbase for Prop+/Split.
pools.geographic_presence: Los Angeles, New York, Europe, Singapore, Dubai, and São Paulo.

pools.name: ca_solohash
pools.notes: Low- and high-difficulty Bitcoin endpoints in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany.
pools.description: SoloHash is a United Kingdom-based solo mining service offering low- and high-difficulty Bitcoin endpoints in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. Charges 0.5% fee and pays directly to the mining address.
pools.payout_method: Direct payout to the mining address.

pools.name: uk_solohash
pools.notes: Low- and high-difficulty Bitcoin endpoints in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany.
pools.description: SoloHash is a United Kingdom-based solo mining service offering low- and high-difficulty Bitcoin endpoints in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. Charges 0.5% fee and pays directly to the mining address.
pools.payout_method: Direct payout to the mining address.

pools.name: de_solohash
pools.notes: Low- and high-difficulty Bitcoin endpoints in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany.
pools.description: SoloHash is a United Kingdom-based solo mining service offering low- and high-difficulty Bitcoin endpoints in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. Charges 0.5% fee and pays directly to the mining address.
pools.payout_method: Direct payout to the mining address.

pools.name: braiins_solo
pools.notes: Registration-free direct-to-address solo mining whose fee contributes to the CKPool open-source stack.
pools.description: Braiins Solo is the solo mining offering from Braiins, powered by the CKPool software stack. It charges 0.5% (which contributes to CKPool's open-source development) and pays the full block reward directly to the miner's address. Registration-free.
pools.payout_method: Direct coinbase (non-custodial).
